text: Proposition thirty-nine would add identification
requirements each time Californians vote.
Citizenship is already required for state and federal
elections.
An in-person voter would instead present government-issued
identification.
The state must offer a free voter identification
card on request.
This is a proposed change,
not instructions for casting your current ballot.
A voter might favor a consistent identification check
as another verification layer and a way to
strengthen confidence.
A skeptical voter could worry about administrative
mistakes, obtaining documents, or navigating new rules.
A free card does not remove every time
or paperwork burden.
Yes adds the proposed requirements;
no retains the current identification framework.
